text:
Inside Salman Khan’s Jaw-Dropping Watch Collection Worth ₹140 Crore
Salman Khan's ₹140 Cr watch collection features ultra-luxury timepieces from Rolex, Patek Philippe and Richard Mille.
Salman Khan launched a luxury watch worth Rs 36.6 lakhs in collaboration with Jacob & Co. Salman Khan launched a luxury watch worth Rs 36.6 lakhs in collaboration with Jacob & Co.
Bollywood megastar Salman Khan isn’t just known for his iconic roles, action-packed blockbusters, or philanthropic ventures, he’s also a serious watch connoisseur. With a collection worth approximately ₹140 crore ($16.75 million), his wrist game is as legendary as his screen presence. Let’s take a closer look at the standout timepieces that adorn the superstar’s wrist, one luxury tick at a time.
1. Jacob & Co – The World is Yours (Salman Khan Edition)
Recommended Stories
Model: REF-DT100.10.AB.AA
Value: ₹36.6 Lakhs / $42,700
Inspired by global ambition, this special edition by Jacob & Co features a colourful dial representing continents, with dual time zones and an intricate design. It’s a perfect match for Salman’s larger-than-life personality and international appeal.
2. Hublot – Spirit of Big Bang Sang Bleu High
Model: REF-648.OX.9010.RX.9904
Value: ₹3.42 Crore / $400,000
A watch that blurs the line between horology and art, this geometric masterpiece is encrusted with baguette diamonds and rose gold elements. Salman sports it with ease, reflecting both strength and sophistication.
View this post on Instagram
3. Rolex – GMT MASTER-II Sapphire Ruby Diamond Pave
Model: REF-126755SARU
Value: ₹2.62 Crore / $270,000
Salman adds sparkle to his wrist with this gem-studded Rolex, featuring sapphire and ruby baguette bezel detailing, and a fully paved diamond dial and bracelet. It’s flamboyant, luxurious, and undeniably exclusive—just like the star himself.
4. Rolex – Sky-Dweller Meteorite Dial With Diamonds
Model: REF-336259TBR
Value: ₹1.8 Crore / $210,000
A cosmic creation, this Rolex features a meteorite dial framed with diamonds. Perfect for the man who truly lives among stars—both figuratively and literally.
5. Rolex – Daytona Platinum Pave Diamond
Model: REF-116576TBR
Value: ₹2.8 Crore / $280,000
Another Rolex gem in Salman’s lineup, this platinum Daytona dazzles with a full diamond-set dial and baguette bezel. It’s one of the brand’s most elite offerings, reflecting true precision and power.
6. Audemars Piguet – Royal Oak Flying Tourbillon Rose Gold
Model: REF-26730OR.OO.1320
Value: ₹2.14 Crore / $250,000
This watch is pure elegance in rose gold. With a flying tourbillon mechanism and refined design, it shows Salman’s appreciation for haute horology craftsmanship.
7. Patek Philippe – Aquanaut Luce Rainbow Minute Repeater Haute Joaillerie
Model: REF-5260/1455R-001
Value: ₹51.4 Crore / $6 Million
Arguably the crown jewel of his collection, this vibrant rainbow-set Patek is encrusted with multicolour sapphires and diamonds. It’s rare, bold, and utterly unique—a wrist-worthy celebration of Salman’s larger-than-life persona.
8. Richard Mille – RM 022 Aerodyne Tourbillon Dual Time Zone
Value: ₹12 Crore / $1.4 Million
Richard Mille watches are the pinnacle of modern luxury, and this complex, skeletonized piece with a dual time zone and tourbillon reflects Salman’s dynamic lifestyle and love for mechanical mastery.
From timeless Rolex icons to futuristic Richard Mille marvels and jaw-dropping haute joaillerie pieces by Patek Philippe, Salman Khan’s watch collection is a blend of power, artistry, and exclusivity. It’s not just about telling time—it’s about making a statement. And Salman’s collection? It screams legacy.
